description: Build a minimal company-operations CRM and licensing control plane for leads, customers, demos, school trials, subscriptions, provisioning, and future sales attribution.
deviation_notes: One Company Admin UI, but a separate company-operations data boundary from employee identity. Revenue and commission behavior is deferred while stable ownership and conversion history are captured now.

sprint.goal: Operate the complete lead-to-customer-to-product-access lifecycle from one small-company admin surface while preserving clean identity, product, and future revenue boundaries.
